en.description:
Raise a tiny pixel pet on your Apple Watch, iPhone, or iPad. Hatch an egg, name your pal, and help it grow through quick moments of care.

Feed it breakfast, play a little game, clean its room, and tuck it in for the night. WatchPals brings the charm of a retro virtual pet to small visits throughout your day.

Discover your next pal
Discover 18 pixel creatures through growth and adoption. Your care shapes how your original pal evolves. As your care level grows, unlock six additional companions: a fox, frog, bear, axolotl, cockatiel, and tiny dragon.

Grow a little family
Earn care points and unlock space for up to seven living pals. Visit one at a time; resting pals pause their needs and growth. Each pet keeps its own name, room, and accessories.

Play on your wrist or phone
Turn the Digital Crown to chase and pounce on Apple Watch, or play Pocket Chase with touch controls on iPhone and iPad. Add the WatchPals complication to open the game from your watch face.

Make it home
Unlock four room themes and accessories as your pal grows. Try a cozy bedroom, a pocket garden, or a starry night. Keep memories of past pets in the family album.

Care at your pace
Choose Relaxed or Classic care, adjust optional reminders and quiet hours, and pick Gentle or Classic life rules. On iPhone and iPad, vacation care pauses your pal's needs while you're away.

Play offline. No ads, subscriptions, or account required.

iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch keep separate pet families. Pets and progress do not sync between devices.
en.releaseNotes:
More pals, one little family!
• Meet six new companions: Clover the fox, Moss the frog, Biscuit the bear, Wisp the axolotl, Tiki the cockatiel, and Nova the tiny dragon.
• Grow your family. Earn care points, unlock new pals, and keep each pet’s name, room, and accessories.
• Automatic iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Share your family, care, and progress between paired devices. Already raising a pet on each? Both stay with you.
• Simpler pixel pals. Enjoy refreshed artwork inspired by the original designs, improved expressions, and matching iPhone and Watch icons.
• Little improvements throughout. Clearer play instructions, better cleaning controls, improved accessibility, and more readable screens.
en.subtitle: Pixel Animals for Apple Watch

zh.description:
A little pal. A lot to love.

Hatch a tiny pixel pet, give it a name, and make a little room in your day for someone new. WatchPal brings the charm of a classic virtual pet to Apple Watch, iPhone, and iPad, with expressive creatures, cozy rooms, and small moments of care that add up.

A meal. A quick game. A good-night visit. Your pal has a life of its own, and your care helps shape what it becomes.

MEET YOUR LITTLE COMPANION
Start with an egg and watch your pal grow. Discover different creatures and personalities as you feed, play, and spend time together.

MAKE THEIR DAY
Choose a meal, snack, or treat. Keep your pal clean, help it rest, and give it medicine when it feels unwell. A little attention goes a long way.

PLAY TOGETHER
Turn the Digital Crown to chase and pounce on Apple Watch. On iPhone and iPad, play Pocket Chase with simple touch controls. Small games make an ordinary minute feel a little more fun.

MAKE IT HOME
Unlock rooms and accessories as your pal grows. Move into a cozy bedroom, enjoy a pocket garden, and find a little look that suits your companion.

KEEP A PAL CLOSE
Enjoy quick visits right on your wrist, with pixel art, little reactions, and haptic feedback. Add the WatchPal complication to open the app from your watch face. Each device has its own pal to raise.

CARE AT YOUR PACE
Choose Relaxed or Classic care and Gentle or Classic life rules. Optional reminders let you know when your pal needs you, with adjustable frequency and quiet hours. On iPhone and iPad, vacation care pauses your pal's needs while you're away.

WatchPal plays offline and does not require an account.

Someone tiny is waiting to meet you.
zh.releaseNotes:
WatchPal is now on iPhone!

• Hatch, name, and care for a little pal from your phone.
• Play Pocket Chase with touch controls.
• Choose rooms and accessories as your pal grows.
• Enjoy new pixel text, using the same typeface as WatchBlocks.
• Get better care reminders with improved quiet hours, health priority, and shortcuts to the right care screen.
• Reminders now respect sound settings and vacation care, with clearer notification permissions.
